title: Zero-row first-batch drain witness does not cover a short page (fewer than 8 wakes)
outcome: A witness seeds fewer than 8 relay home wakes with a one-shot zero-row first batch and asserts every wake is delivered after the drain, so the home_attempted == rows.len() conjunct of the recorded scan-complete flag is discriminated.
acceptance: Zero-row first-batch drain witness does not cover a short page (fewer than 8 wakes) is done
